sources.title: r/LocalLLaMA on Reddit: IMPORTANT: Why Abliterated Models SUCK. Here is a better way to uncensor LLMs.
Abliterated Models 2026: The Best Uncensored GGUFs by VRAM (Qwen 3.6, Gemma 4, Llama)
sources.snippet: Llama 4 Scout (17B active, 16 experts, ~109B total) is Meta’s MoE model with native vision and long context. A working abliterated GGUF is live: mradermacher/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct-abliterated-GGUF — mradermacher’s quant of jiangchengchengNLP’s abliteration. Imatrix quants live in the companion -i1-GGUF repo.
